notes:
Code tab and AI prompts in both plugins; Help tabs tidied

TCC Website Features 0.5.0 and Planning Center Sync 0.10.0.

- New Code tab: an administrator can see and edit a feature's code. The edit
  is saved as a separate copy and the original is never changed, so one button
  puts it back. An edit with a typing mistake is refused; one that causes an
  error switches itself off and the original runs again.
- AI prompts: a ready-made briefing for an AI assistant for each feature and
  for each plugin, with copy buttons, for people without access to GitHub.
- Help tabs: jump links, troubleshooting grouped by part of the website, and
  new panels on changing the code and asking an AI assistant.
- Planning Center Sync: the sync code moved, unchanged, from the main file to
  sync.php so it can be edited like the other files.
